name: Brake (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Brake (Unterweser) (quartered with eagle, Oldenburg bars and a sailing ship).
history: Municipal flag of Brake; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Brake arms — quartered with eagle, bars and ship
